blurb: Dublin Ranch Golf Course is proud to be the first and only golf course in Dublin, CA. This Robert Trent Jones, Jr., par 63 layout boasts 11 unique par 3s, five solid par 4s, and two demanding par 5s. Skilled club selection is critical, with most players utilizing every club in their bag during their round.
